Page 1072 
 
 1.2 Treatment of hematologic toxicity from folic acid antagonists (i.e., pyrimethamine toxicity 
treatment or trimethoprim toxicity treatment)  
 
OR 
 
 1.3 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting a diagnosis of cerebral 
folate deficiency (CFD)
